Subject: Urgent: SOC 2 Type II & interim attestation request to unblock procurement

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Procurement flagged that the contract team needs a SOC 2 Type II report (recent period) or an interim attestation / bridge for us to move forward with the PO. The deal is currently blocked on the audit artifact (see HubSpot HS: deal_4529).

Can you confirm which of the following would unblock you quickly?

- Full SOC 2 Type II PDF for the most recent period (preferred)
- Interim attestation letter (signed) + evidence bundle mapping (we can provide a template)
- Temporary bridge attestation confirming controls in place while report is produced

We can commit to an accelerated evidence handoff if you accept the attestation path. I attached a short checklist of evidence we typically provide to speed validation.

Attachments: Requested_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (stub)

Would love to get a confirmation today so we can engage Security & Legal immediately.

Best,
Ben Carter

Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: SOC 2 Type II & interim attestation request to unblock procurement

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the checklist. Our security reviewer needs either: (a) SOC 2 Type II for the last 12 months, or (b) a signed interim attestation plus an evidence index that maps controls to artifacts. Procurement will accept the interim route but needs Letter + evidence table within 72 hours to keep the supplier approval on track.

If you can provide the attestation and a CSV mapping of artifacts to control criteria (or a drive link), we can push the PO forward while you complete the full report.

We will loop legal once we have the attestation. Appreciate any quick help — this is blocking our Q4 integration milestone.

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaMed
eruiz@novamed.com

Folks —

Forwarding NovaMed's ask: they will accept an interim attestation + evidence map within 72 hours to unblock the PO. Deal: NVMD-4529 (HS: deal_4529). This is a sizeable PLG expansion opener; Vivek, asking for your sign-off to kick a 48–72h evidence sprint.

Suggested approach from my side:
- Security prepares a one-page interim attestation (we have a template).
- We produce an evidence index CSV linking control ids (SOC 2 common criteria) to artifacts in our drive.
- Legal signs the attestation and provides a DocuSign link.

Can Rishi / Stephanie confirm: 1) feasibility within 72h, 2) who owns evidence collection, 3) recommended scope to keep the attestation conservative but acceptable to procurement.

Ben

Ben / team —

We can do an interim attestation + evidence index within 48 hours if we scope it tightly. Proposed minimal scope to satisfy procurement: SOC 2 CC1-CC6 mapping for cloud infrastructure + access controls + change management (these are the items NovaMed highlighted in their security questionnaire).

Action plan:
1) I'll drop a draft interim attestation (using our template) by EOD today.
2) Laura / Security Ops to pull evidence artifacts: policies, access control screenshots, audit logs extract, patching dashboard export. Laura, can you own artifact collection and put files in Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNOVAMED-evidence ?
3) Stephanie to confirm legal sign-off language and prepare DocuSign.
4) Ben to coordinate with Elena for acceptance and share the DocuSign link.

Attachments: SOC2_Interim_Attestation_Template.docx (stub)

Rishi Malhotra

Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: SOC 2 Type II & interim attestation request to unblock procurement

Ben / team —

I reviewed the draft language Rishi referenced. Legal can sign a conservative interim attestation that states: 1) control objectives in place as of the attestation date, 2) evidence is provided in support and mapped to the control criteria, and 3) the attestation is not a substitute for a full SOC 2 report. That wording satisfies most procurement teams and limits downstream legal exposure.

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope this afternoon. Ben, when the evidence folder is live, share the Drive link in the DocuSign message and with Elena directly.

-Stephanie
